title: 第1542章 三不在第1541章 阴阳三合
lines: 诸气不生、万类不存的真空沟壑，横亘在苏午与‘三不在之地’之间，犹如拦阻在他前方的天垫。
他遥望三不在之地，彼处元河大水寂静凝滞着，三清与大天并立于三不在之地——这漫漫元河铺满了苏午的视野，哪怕今时已临‘真空沟壑’，已近‘三不在之地’，他仍旧看不到元河尽头所在。
但是，自以故始社稷大鼎开启祭祀以后，苏午已知元河有其尽头，元河尽头之处，还漂浮着一副漆黑棺椁，以及众多恐怖气韵。
此行他的目的即是踏临元河尽头，打开那副漆黑棺椁，拿回其中与自身相连的一道‘本我’，彻底证就‘诸我归一’。
诸我归一之境，自然没有那么容易证就。
元河尽头的棺椁之内，必然留存着某个未明存在的恐怖手段——自苏午打开那副棺椁开始，或许就是他同时面临化为真仙以前的‘情关’、‘生死大关’之时。
这一路千难万险。
当下尤有三清、大天拦阻在三不在之地，阻止苏午涉过真空沟壑。
它们二者已是宇宙洪荒之中执牛耳者，然而苏午面临二者的拦阻，神色之间却也无甚忧虑，他目光静定，将白色仙虹缭绕周身的柳飞烟放在了身畔，继而张口一吐，吐出一团灿灿金光。
金光犹如水液凝练着，顷刻化作故始社稷大鼎。
此人道巨鼎，被苏午一分为十，其中九鼎坐落于天柱支撑起的彼方天地之中，他所持者，其实是十鼎之一，威能比之从前已经衰弱太多，但这尊主鼎仍旧保留了最为重要的‘祭祀’、‘尚飨’之能。
主鼎与天柱世界之中的九鼎之间，仍有气脉牵连。
人道潮流周转于十鼎之间，以苏午所持主鼎为源头，滚滚飨宴烟气一面向着元河尽头游曳，一面向着其余九鼎流淌，彼方天地之中，又不知有多少人聚集在九鼎之下，受用这忽然而来的一场人道飨食了。
飨宴烟气似潮水涉入真空沟壑，滚滚烟气在真空沟壑之中，存留不住一个刹那，即有被真空消解的趋势。
然而，在此时，身躯浸润于这飨宴烟气中的苏午，忽然间看到了一个画面——那充斥一道道恐怖气韵的元河尽头之中，留存有一汪迥异于元河空明大水，化分斑斓五色的泉池里，那副漆黑棺椁微微颤抖着，它的勾召呼唤，竟使得那行将消解于真空沟壑里的飨食烟气，一瞬间升腾而上，越过了那道真空沟壑，朝元河尽头而去——
只是可惜，这般飨宴烟气太过淡薄，盖因内中烹煮的飨食品质低下，只是苏午自元河逆流而上之时，顺手收集来的几道彼岸，投入鼎中所作飨宴，它们能被元河尽头的棺椁勾召，出离真空沟壑，却越不过三不在之地耸立的三清与大天——
二者只是动念之间，滚滚飨宴烟气便尽数崩灭作无。
元河尽头的漆黑棺椁，也只得重归寂静，在那片被恐怖气韵侵染了的五色斑斓泉池之中，沉沉浮浮。
三清看着苏午所化漆黑长龙盘绕着那尊金鼎，它眼中一片寂暗：“你欲以此鼎沟通元河尽头的棺椁……以它来牵制吾与大天？
你应当并不知道……
不论是吾或是大天，皆不能抵至元河尽头去，而元河尽头的那副棺椁，亦被永恒困在元河尽头，不能由元河尽头顺流而下……”
双方皆是‘王不见王’的状态，如此以来，又如何争斗得起来？
苏午的算盘，因三清这番解释，看似是要落空了。
然而，苏午闻声却笑道：“那副棺椁中的存在，今下不能揭棺而起，所以不能自元河尽头顺流而下，与两位‘相见叙旧’。
但假若它苏醒了呢？
它一旦苏醒，揭棺而起，莫非还不能顺流而下，见到两位么？”
三清闻声沉默。
大天则道：“自它被人葬在那副棺椁之中开始，它便不曾苏醒过，你以何法，令它苏醒？”
“仙被他所杀。
元皇脑髓，今被他所掌握。”
三清这时出声，令大天一刹那明白，苏午的凭恃究竟是甚么，它看向苏午，出声说道，“元皇脑髓，何其珍贵？仙凭借元皇脑髓与大天血液，生来即在‘三不在之地’，离真仙境界最近。
content_en:
The empty ravine where all qi does not arise and where all kinds of things do not exist lies between Su Wu and the "Three Absence Places", like a heavenly mat blocking his way.
He looked at the Land of Three Absences in the distance, where the Yuan River was silent and stagnant, and the Three Pure Ones and the Great Sky stood side by side in the Land of Three Absences - this long Yuan River filled Su Wu's field of vision. Even though he was now in the 'vacuum ravine' and close to the 'Land of Three Absences', he still could not see the end of the Yuan River.
However, since the Great Cauldron of Sheji was opened for sacrifice, Su Wu knew that the Yuan River had its end. At the end of the Yuan River, there was still a dark coffin floating, as well as many terrifying auras.
His purpose for this trip was to reach the end of the Yuan River, open the dark coffin, take back the 'self' connected to himself, and completely realize the 'unity of all selves'.
The state of the unity of all selves is naturally not that easy to achieve.
In the coffin at the end of the Yuan River, there must be some unknown terrorist method - from the time Su Wu opened the coffin, it may have been the time when he faced the 'love test' and the 'life and death test' before turning into a true immortal.
This journey is full of difficulties and dangers.
At this moment, there were especially the Three Pure Ones and the Great Heaven blocking the place where the Three Absences were, preventing Su Wu from crossing the vacuum ravine.
The two of them are already the leaders in the universe, but Su Wu didn't look worried when faced with the obstruction of the two. He looked calmly and placed Liu Feiyan, surrounded by a white fairy rainbow, next to him, then opened his mouth and spit out a ball of brilliant golden light.
The golden light condensed like water and instantly turned into the great cauldron of Gushi Sheji.
This huge human cauldron was divided into ten by Su Wu. Nine of the cauldrons are located in the world supported by the sky pillars. The one he holds is actually one of the ten cauldrons. Its power has been much weaker than before, but this main cauldron still retains the most important functions of 'sacrifice' and 'shangfang'.
There is still a connection between the main cauldron and the Jiuding in the Tianzhu world.
The current of human nature circulates among the ten tripods, with the main tripod held by Su Wu as the source. The billowing smoke of the feast swam toward the end of the Yuan River and flowed toward the other nine tripods. In the world beyond, countless people gathered under the nine tripods to enjoy this sudden human feast.
The smoke from the banquet flows into the vacuum ravine like a tide. The billowing smoke cannot survive in the vacuum ravine for even a moment, and has a tendency to be dissipated by the vacuum.
However, at this moment, Su Wu, whose body was immersed in the smoke of the feast, suddenly saw a scene - at the end of the Yuan River, which was full of terrifying auras, there was a clear water that was completely different from the Yuan River, divided into five colors. In the colorful spring pool, the pitch-black coffin trembled slightly, and its call made the food smoke that was about to disappear in the vacuum ravine rise up in an instant, cross the vacuum ravine, and head towards the end of the Yuan River——
It's a pity that the smoke of such a feast is too weak, because the food cooked in it is of low quality. When Su Wu went upstream from the Yuan River, he collected a few pieces from the other side and threw them into the cauldron to make a feast. They could be summoned by the coffin at the end of the Yuan River and escape from the vacuum ravine, but they could not surpass the three clear mountains and the sky that stood in the Three Absent Places——
The two of them just thought about it, and all the billowing smoke of the feast collapsed into nothingness.
The dark coffin at the end of the Yuan River had no choice but to return to silence, sinking and floating in the colorful spring pool infected by the terrifying aura.
Sanqing looked at the long black dragon transformed by Su Wu and circled the golden cauldron. Its eyes were filled with darkness: "You want to use this cauldron to communicate with the coffin at the end of the Yuan River...use it to contain me and the heaven?"
You probably don't know...
Neither I nor Datian can reach the end of the Yuan River, and the coffin at the end of the Yuan River is also eternally trapped at the end of the Yuan River and cannot flow downstream from the end of the Yuan River..."
Both sides are in a state of "the king cannot see the king". How can they fight since then?
Su Wu's plan seemed to be in vain because of Sanqing's explanation.
However, when Su Wu heard the sound, he smiled and said: "The existence in that coffin cannot be lifted up now, so it cannot go down the river from the end of Yuan River to 'meet and reminisce' with the two of them.
But what if it wakes up?
Once it wakes up and rises from its coffin, wouldn't it be able to go down the river and see the two of them? "
Sanqing was silent when he heard the sound.
Datianze said: "Since it was buried in that coffin, it has never woken up. How can you make it wake up?"
"The immortal was killed by him.
The brains of Emperor Yuan are now under his control. "
Sanqing spoke at this time, making Datian instantly understand what Su Wu was relying on. It looked at Su Wu and said, "How precious is Yuanhuang's brain? Immortals rely on Yuanhuang's brain and Datian's blood to be born in the 'Three Absences', which is closest to the realm of true immortals."
